shape.description: Flat jigsaw-edged plate. Each cell has a raised square frame with a square window through to the table and four small corner studs. Block legs sit around the frame. Plates interlock by jigsaw tabs on their edges. 4 by 2 cells.
shape.sizeBasis: Scale is estimated, not measured: one cell = one block width (top-down maps, trex_plans_27). A cell of about 45 mm is judged from hand and laptop-key size in IMG_0960/0963, +-5 mm. No ruler was in any photo.

accepts: feet of blocks and base modules, one per cell

physics.behaviour: Holds the build. A marble can drop through a window.

evidence.shows: plate studs, windows, jigsaw edges; legs straddle frames
cells and isolated rows from short plates
